title: Geologic map of Jasper quadrangle, Beaufort and Jasper Counties, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2001, Geologic map of Jasper quadrangle, Beaufort and Jasper Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-137, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Page 1 is the map sheet; pages 2-4 are unrelated symbol-style notes appended to the download (no values taken). Map symbols assigned from description boxes on the page image, flagged inferred. Section A-A' holes read from page-image tiles and checked against colour columns sampled from the PDF; elevations in ft off the feet scale (below-sea-level labels printed without a minus sign; recorded negative). Hole positions along the section and contacts between holes not recorded (no horizontal scale printed on the section). 25-99 and 7-175 are drawn above the profile and 7-147 starts below it: no land-surface elevation for these. The section labels the Miocene unit 'Nmd' (NMd in the description). Map-face drill-hole labels have no printed locations.
